description.value: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is a major fast food chain known for Southern-style fried chicken, located on Fraser Highway in Langley. It offers takeout service and sits along a busy commercial corridor that touring cyclists on the Fraser Valley routes may pass through. As a national chain franchise, the experience is consistent and predictable for a quick calorie stop.
